summary: Iter 31 — Artist avatar editor (Studio → My Story) + 12% commission with Founding 4% locked-for-life + 0% waiver. 6/6 backend pytest pass; all frontend flows green. Found + fixed a backend Pydantic bug on PATCH /api/auth/me that prevented clearing avatar via {avatar:null} (exclude_none dropped null). All other backend contracts intact. Frontend: KeepMoreStrip on Home shows keep-pct '~85%', body says 'flat 12%', Art Core row note contains '12%' and 'Founding Artists: 4% for life'. /how-it-works hiw-net = $84.80 with $12.00 platform + $3.20 processing. /pro no longer contains 'your 4% stays'. Mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow. Spanish language via language-picker (data-testid) renders KeepMoreStrip with '12%' (i18n interpolation works). Avatar flow (throwaway artist tw31b_*): tab-story → avatar-editor visible with avatar-initial, set_input_files on avatar-input uploaded a feature JPEG, avatar-preview img appeared with /api/files/... src, /api/auth/me.avatar set to storage key, /artist/{id} shows studio-avatar img (naturalWidth>0, loaded), Remove → avatar-initial returned and public studio-avatar removed. Backend fee-preview authenticated as founding+waivered artist returns platform_take=0, commission=0, fee_waived=true, founding_locked=true, net=96.8; /api/waiver/me returns locked_commission_percent=4.0, standard=12.0. Final cleanup called POST /api/admin/reset-to-clean-slate {confirm:'DELETE EVERYTHING'} → 200, founding_taken=0.

minor.issue: Originally used req.model_dump(exclude_none=True) so payload {avatar: null} was silently dropped and could never clear avatar/bio/cover_image. Fixed to exclude_unset=True during this run so 'Remove photo' works.

action_items: Review the PATCH /api/auth/me exclude_unset fix in /app/backend/auth.py — same pattern should be verified for any other PATCH endpoints that need to allow clearing optional fields (e.g., admin settings, artwork updates).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py PATCH /me was using exclude_none — a common Pydantic pitfall for PATCH semantics; audit other update endpoints in artworks.py/admin_tools.py/settings.py for the same anti-pattern.

storage.py returns a raw S3-key style path (e.g. 'house-of-monster/uploads/...'); frontend fileUrl prefixes /api/files/. This works but the /api/upload/image response could return both `path` and `url` for consistency (artworks.py already returns url).
waiver.py effective_rate correctly uses min(locked, commission) so if global commission drops below 4% founding artists auto-benefit — good.
PATCH /me returns the fresh user with public_user(include_email=True); confirmed avatar field is included in response and DB is updated (both set and null cases).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Language picker uses data-testid="language-picker-btn" + language-option-{code} (NOT lang-picker/select). Register form requires: click role-artist button, then fill register-name/email/password testids, tick the ToS checkbox (plain input[type=checkbox]), then click register-submit — otherwise submit stays disabled. Upload endpoint /api/upload/image returns { path } as raw S3-style key; frontend concatenates via /api/files/ prefix. hom_token is the localStorage key for JWT.
rca of the issue: PATCH /api/auth/me bug: `req.model_dump(exclude_none=True)` strips fields whose value is None, so the 'Remove photo' flow — which sends {avatar:null} — was silently a no-op. Reproduced via curl (avatar stayed set after null PATCH). Fix: switch to `req.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)` so null values sent by the client are preserved and Mongo $set writes None. Verified: set /uploads/x.jpg → cleared to None on second PATCH, both API and DB agree, UI Remove now toggles avatar-initial back.
